Martinsville Minis: Big Cubes 2026 


Please Note:  This competition does NOT include 3x3x3. 


EVENTS:
4x4 - 3 Rounds
5x5 - 3 Rounds
6x6 - 3 Rounds
7x7 - 3 Rounds

This competition is being supported by Midwest Cubing Association. Central Indiana Speedcubing Club is helping with setup and tear down.

The venue allows food & non alcoholic drinks to be brought in.  It is a non smoking venue.  As always, be courteous and clean up any spills & trash.
